verdict.rationale: Feature flags are a fair question for an analytics product, since peers in the category ship flags and experiments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no feature-flag capability. The Stats API is read-only, the Events API only records pageviews and events, and there is no evidence of an MCP server.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent create, target, and toggle feature flags through the API or MCP server
